source.title: ISNIC, the .is registry: the holder of althingi.is is Alþingi, the Icelandic Parliament, which publishes the law collection (Lagasafn)
ISNIC, the .is registry: the holder of island.is is Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneyti, the Ministry of Finance, whose state portal hosts the regulation collection and the official gazette
ISNIC, the .is registry: the holder of stjornartidindi.is is Dómsmálaráðuneyti, the Ministry of Justice, which publishes the official gazette Stjórnartíðindi
